name: fontget
description: Font installer with many sources: Google Fonts, Nerd Fonts, Fontsource, Fontshare and more

notes.text: FontGet's per-user installs don't survive a reboot yet (https://github.com/Graphixa/FontGet/issues/9). Install with --scope machine (admin), or use Install-DFNerdFont or the NerdFonts module.
